title: Specchem LLC
description: About Specchem LLC Specchem LLC is a U.S.-based supplier of concrete repair materials, flooring products, and chemical admixtures. The company offers a range of cementitious and epoxy-based systems. Their distribution network covers domestic commercial and industrial contractors. A cyberattack on Specchem LLC resulted in a massive data breach. As a result of the incident, approximately 500 GB of data—containing roughly 700,000 files, including confidential personal and financial information—was stolen.
